name: Seiiki ~Nageki no Usagi~
source:
Hero is invited to an isolated island prison camp to analyze a girl's psyche. The six prisoners who he is in charge for start to disappear one after another. Hero has to go through temptation and traps to unravel the mystery of the isolated island campus.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公被邀请到一座孤岛监狱去分析一个女孩的心理。他负责的六名囚犯开始一个接一个地消失。主人公必须经历诱惑和陷阱，揭开孤岛营地的秘密。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
